data.long_description:
Spacious 3-Bedroom with Bridge, Water & Pool Views | Palazzo Versace Dubai

This well-priced 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom apartment in Palazzo Versace Dubai offers a rare opportunity to own a spacious, elegantly finished home in one of Dubai’s most iconic residences.

Key Features:

• 3 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms
• Bridge, Creek & Pool Views from the living area and bedrooms
• Open-plan kitchen with high-end appliances
• Signature Versace interior design elements throughout
• Separate laundry and storage area
• 5-star hotel facilities including concierge, valet, spa, gym, and multiple pools
• Secure basement parking
• Prime location close to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and the airport


Positioned to capture serene water views, the iconic Dubai Creek bridge, and the beautifully landscaped pool area, the apartment combines luxurious living with a peaceful ambiance.
